mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, topic_name, type, sort, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{topicName}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, topic_name, type, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, topic_name, type, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM category ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, topic_name, type, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, topic_name, type, sort, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE type = #{type} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE type = #{type} AND name = #{name}
